blockers.detail: Walkenhorst migrated its browser export core from realtime MediaRecorder/captureStream to deterministic WebMotion/WebCodecs. DG-MAIN has no lib/studio-v3-browser-render-core.ts or equivalent browser render seam that can receive the same adaptation without inventing a parallel Studio architecture. Peer status records the same blocker; runtime/customer data remain isolated.

rules: Shared product improvements must be adapted to the peer instance in the same task.
Never copy customer data, credentials, Supabase refs, branding, PV-specific logic or Walkenhorst-specific content into another instance.
Do not mark a shared-core task complete until both instances are adapted or a blocker is recorded in both status files.
